title: Photoreal Blender recreation of the Somebody Get These Beggars Out of Here shot

source_context.shot: Antinous delivers the viral line at the Ithaca banquet
source_context.reference_use: Download only inside the local worker for reconstruction, camera matching and visual comparison. Do not commit the copyrighted reference media to GitHub or package it into deliverables.

creative_target.fidelity_goal: Recreate the original live-action shot as photorealistically as the local hardware permits, including actor likeness. This is not a stylized meme remake.
priority_order: Robert Pattinson likeness and asymmetrical grin
exact close-up framing and head angle
warm orange-red skin lighting and deep black costume
shallow depth of field with amber circular bokeh
short facial performance and line timing
banquet-hall context outside the focal plane

reference_frame.expression: broad asymmetric contemptuous grin, upper teeth visible, left brow slightly raised
reference_frame.costume: near-black ancient tunic or cloak merging into background
reference_frame.lighting: strong warm key from camera-left/front, weak warm rim, nearly black fill
reference_frame.background: dark Ithacan feast hall rendered as soft warm shapes and round fire bokeh

creative_target.final_renderer: Cycles GPU when VRAM preflight passes; Eevee Next fallback for proof renders
creative_target.dialogue: Somebody get these beggars out of here!
creative_target.audio_policy: Use locally obtained reference audio only for timing analysis. Do not redistribute it. Final deliverable may be silent unless a legally usable user-supplied or synthetic track is available.

reconstruction_pipeline.primary_face_route: DECA or EMOCA detailed expressive reconstruction when an already authorized FLAME environment is available
reconstruction_pipeline.automatic_fallback_face_route: Pinned 3DDFA_V2 ONNX reconstruction with OBJ vertex colors and Blender-side corrective sculpting
reconstruction_pipeline.body_route: camera-specific neck, shoulders and black costume built in Blender because only the close-up silhouette is visible
reconstruction_pipeline.hair_route: procedural scalp cap plus groomed curves/cards matched to the reference silhouette
reconstruction_pipeline.set_route: minimal physical banquet geometry plus practical emissive lamps placed to reproduce reference bokeh
reconstruction_pipeline.camera_route: reference-overlay camera match followed by overlay removal before final render
reconstruction_pipeline.comparison_route: render/reference contact sheet plus image metrics on a face-and-lighting crop; metrics are advisory and visual inspection remains decisive

worker_policy.source_of_truth: the exact checked-out github.sha on the dedicated branch
